user_query: I need news about Covid 19 from multiple sources. Please gather news articles, headlines, authors, and publication dates from sources like WHO, CNN, and the guardian.

TaskList.description: Gather news articles from the WHO website including headlines, authors, and publication dates.
Gather news articles from CNN including headlines, authors, and publication dates.
Gather news articles from The Guardian including headlines, authors, and publication dates.
Compile and merge all collected news articles from WHO, CNN, and The Guardian into a single document or list.
